thread:
sophia: heads-up — enabling the FP8 kernel on L40S for atlas-13b canary (region: us-west). throughput +1.9x on short seqs but seeing a quality bump on long-prefix evals and one NaN during a 16k token run. rolling back if needed :thinking:
raj: numbers pls — what eval and delta? logs? model variant?@marta FYI
marta: usual suspects: kv-cache alignment + tiling mismatch, activation saturation when we mix FP8 with residual scaling on long contexts. also check compilation flags (autotile vs explicit)
james: i hit a NaN on a 16384 step trace earlier, stack shows matmul overflow in kernel fp8_gemm.cu:line 412. saved trace in /tmp/canary-nan-2654.log
deploy-bot: canary deployed: release=canary/fp8-boot-2026-03-20 id=canary-2654, traffic=2%, region=us-west, config=fp8-enabled, tiling=auto, fallback=enabled
sophia: quick numbers: short-ctx (128) tokens/s 1800 -> 3400, latency p50 22ms -> 12ms. long-ctx (8k prefix) ppl delta +0.6 (baseline fp32), top1 token accuracy down ~0.8% on our LLM-eval longprefix subset. NaN occurred once in 4200 requests.

sophia: config snippet used for canary:
```yaml
model: atlas-13b
device: L40S
enable_fp8: true
quant_profile: fp8-e2e-v3
autotile: true
tiling_align: 32
fallback_policy: [fp32, fp16]
kv_cache_shard: 4
```
raj: can you re-run with `tiling_align: 64` and `autotile: false`? that alignment has fixed off-by-one slice issues before. also try `rescale_clip: 8.0` in the quant_profile to avoid activation blowups
marta: also compare against AWQ/GPTQ INT8 baseline — FP8 can be fragile for long prefixes if the activation distribution drifts. open a small eval that forces long-token drift and check per-layer max activations
james: paste from trace (sanitized):
```
[WARN] step=4123 layer=attn_kv matmul overflow detected: max=1.2e3, scale=0.000122, producing inf at output
[INFO] fallback triggered for request id=ebb4f, fallback_to=fp32
```
sophia: good catch. fallback did trigger for that request. plan: 1) spin a new canary with autotile=false, tiling_align=64, rescale_clip bump, 2) add longprefix regression test to eval harness (seeded prompts we saw delta on), 3) shadow traffic with AWQ/GPTQ int8 to compare unit economics, 4) hold rollout until 24h of stable long-ctx ppls. volunteers?
raj: i'll run canary config change and run 1000 long-ctx evals overnight (on dedicated test pool). will also run per-layer activation heatmap and send results tomorrow morning
marta: i'll add the regression to continuous eval and create a short runbook section: "fp8 longprefix checklist" (tiling align, rescale_clip, kv-shard parity, fallback thresholds). will PR by EOD
james: i'll dig into the matmul path and add saturation guards + clearer logging so we can map layer->request quickly
deploy-bot: canary metrics (6h): error-rate 0.12% -> 0.18% (delta +0.06), fallback-count 1/4200 -> 3/4200 after spike, perf stable, rollouts paused
sophia: thanks all. prioritize regressions first — these quality deltas show up in customer traces. if the alignment change fixes it we'll re-enable auto tiling later. tagging @raj @marta for follow-up. :eyes:
raj: noted, will update thread when finished
sophia: thanks :thumbsup:
